summary: As a user, I want to see my authored posts and uploaded media on my Profile Page so that I can review my content history and manage my digital footprint.

test_cases.title: Default Posts tab selected and posts displayed in reverse chronological order
test_cases.preconditions: User is authenticated and has at least 5 public posts
test_cases.steps:
Given the user navigates to their Profile Page
When the screen loads
Then the "Posts" tab must be selected by default
And the system queries the Post API and returns posts sorted newest to oldest
And the first 10 posts are rendered in the list
test_cases.expected_result: The Posts tab is active and the list shows the 10 most recent posts with correct order

test_cases.title: Infinite scroll loads next set of posts when scrolled to bottom
test_cases.preconditions: User has 25 posts
test_cases.steps:
Given the user is on the Profile Page with the Posts tab active
When the user scrolls to the bottom of the post list
Then the system requests the next 10 posts via the Post API
And the new posts are appended to the list
test_cases.expected_result: 15 posts are visible after first scroll, 25 after second scroll

test_cases.title: Post text truncated at 200 characters with "Read more" link
test_cases.preconditions: User has a post with 250 characters of text
test_cases.steps:
Given the user is on the Profile Page
When the post list is rendered
Then the post card displays only the first 200 characters followed by "Read more"
And clicking "Read more" expands to full text
test_cases.expected_result: 200-char preview shown; full text revealed on click

test_cases.title: Post card displays media preview correctly for image posts
test_cases.preconditions: User has a post with an image URL
test_cases.steps:
Given the user is on the Profile Page
When the post list is rendered
Then the media preview area shows the image thumbnail
And clicking the thumbnail opens the image in a lightbox
test_cases.expected_result: Thumbnail visible and lightbox opens with full image

test_cases.title: Post card shows visibility icon for followers-only posts
test_cases.preconditions: User has a followers-only post
test_cases.steps:
Given the user is on the Profile Page
When the post list is rendered
Then the visibility icon indicates "followers-only"
And the post is not visible to non-followers in API response

test_cases.title: Empty profile shows no posts and displays placeholder message
test_cases.preconditions: User has zero posts
test_cases.steps:
Given the user navigates to their Profile Page
When the screen loads
Then the system queries the Post API and receives an empty list
And the UI displays "You have no posts yet" message
test_cases.expected_result: No post cards rendered; placeholder visible
edge_cases: API returns null instead of empty array

test_cases.title: API returns error 500 during post fetch shows error banner
test_cases.preconditions: Post API is mocked to return 500
test_cases.steps:
Given the user navigates to their Profile Page
When the system requests posts
Then the API returns 500
And the UI displays an error banner with retry option
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner visible; retry button functional

test_cases.title: User with 11 posts sees pagination load 10 then 1
test_cases.preconditions: User has 11 posts
test_cases.steps:
Given the user is on the Profile Page
When the user scrolls to bottom once
Then the system fetches the next 10 posts
And only 1 additional post is displayed

test_cases.title: Rapid scrolling triggers multiple API calls but no duplicate posts
test_cases.preconditions: User has 30 posts
test_cases.steps:
Given the user is on the Profile Page
When the user scrolls rapidly to bottom multiple times
Then the system queues API requests but ensures each post appears only once

test_cases.title: Session expires during infinite scroll and user is redirected to login
test_cases.preconditions: User session expires after 5 minutes
test_cases.steps:
Given the user is on the Profile Page and has scrolled halfway
When the session token expires
Then subsequent API calls return 401
And the UI redirects to the login page
test_cases.expected_result: Login page displayed; no stale data shown

test_cases.title: Post with zero-width space in text renders correctly and truncates

test_cases.title: Rapid Tab Switching Does Not Trigger Duplicate API Calls
test_cases.preconditions: User has posts and media
test_cases.steps:
Given the user is on the Profile Page
When the user quickly toggles between Posts and Media tabs 5 times
Then each tab must call its API only once per visit and not duplicate requests
test_cases.expected_result: No duplicate network traffic; UI remains responsive

test_cases.title: Posts Tab Handles Zero-Width Space in Title Gracefully
test_cases.preconditions: User has a post with title containing zero-width space
test_cases.steps:
Given the user is on the Profile Page
When the post card is rendered
Then the title must display correctly without breaking layout

test_cases.title: Media Tab Shows Correct Empty State When Viewing Another User
test_cases.preconditions: User A views User B's profile; User B has no media
test_cases.steps:
Given User A is on User B's profile
When the Media tab is selected
Then the page must display "User B hasn’t uploaded any media yet."

test_cases.title: Posts Tab Handles 1 Post Exactly at Limit Boundary
test_cases.preconditions: User has exactly 1 post
test_cases.steps:
Given the user is on the Profile Page
When the Posts API returns 1 post
Then the post card must be displayed and no pagination controls shown

test_cases.title: Posts Tab Handles 11 Posts (One Above Pagination Limit)
test_cases.preconditions: User has 11 posts
test_cases.steps:
Given the user is on the Profile Page
When the Posts API returns 11 posts
Then the first 10 posts are displayed and infinite scroll loads the 11th on scroll

test_cases.title: Posts Tab Handles 0 Posts (Below Pagination Limit)
test_cases.preconditions: User has 0 posts
test_cases.steps:
Given the user is on the Profile Page
When the Posts API returns an empty array
Then the empty state message is shown and no pagination controls appear

test_cases.title: Keyboard Navigation to Posts Tab Works Correctly
test_cases.preconditions: User is on the Profile Page
test_cases.steps:
Given the user focuses on the tab list with Tab key
When the user presses ArrowRight to move to the Media tab
Then the Media tab must become active and its content loaded
test_cases.expected_result: Keyboard navigation functional; focus outline visible

test_cases.title: Screen Reader Announces Empty State in Posts Tab
test_cases.preconditions: User has no posts
test_cases.steps:
Given the user navigates to the Profile Page
When the Posts tab is active and empty state is displayed
Then a screen reader must announce "You haven’t posted yet."

test_cases.title: API Rejects Posts Request with Invalid Offset Parameter
test_cases.preconditions: User is authenticated
test_cases.steps:
Given the user sends a Posts API request with offset=-5
When the server processes the request
Then the response status must be 400 Bad Request with error message

test_cases.title: Media Tab Lightbox Handles Non-Image File Gracefully
test_cases.preconditions: User has a PDF uploaded as media
test_cases.steps:
Given the user is on the Profile Page and the Media tab is active
When the user clicks on the PDF thumbnail
Then the lightbox must display a placeholder icon and a download link

test_cases.title: Profile Page Loads Correctly on Mobile Breakpoint
test_cases.preconditions: Viewport width set to 375px
test_cases.steps:
Given the user navigates to the Profile Page on mobile viewport
When the page renders
Then the Posts and Media tabs must stack vertically and be fully accessible

test_cases.title: Default Posts Tab Loads with 10 Posts on Profile Page
test_cases.preconditions: User is authenticated and has at least 15 posts.
test_cases.steps:
Given the user navigates to /profile
When the page loads
Then the Posts tab is selected by default
And the system queries the Post API with limit=10
And 10 post cards are rendered in reverse chronological order
test_cases.expected_result: 10 posts displayed, newest first, Posts tab active

test_cases.title: Infinite Scroll Loads Next 10 Posts When Scrolled to Bottom
test_cases.preconditions: User has 25 posts.
test_cases.steps:
Given the user is on the Posts tab with 10 posts displayed
When the user scrolls to the bottom of the list
Then the system requests the next 10 posts
And 20 posts are displayed in total
test_cases.expected_result: 20 posts rendered, no duplicate or missing items

test_cases.title: Posts Tab Shows Truncated Text with Read More Link for 250-Char Posts
test_cases.preconditions: User has a post with 250 characters of text.
test_cases.steps:
Given the user is on the Posts tab
When the post card is rendered
Then the text is truncated to 200 characters
And a 'Read more' link is visible
test_cases.expected_result: 200-char preview + link, full text on click

test_cases.title: Posts Tab Handles Zero Posts Gracefully
test_cases.preconditions: User has no posts.
test_cases.steps:
Given the user navigates to /profile
When the Posts tab loads
Then the system displays 'No posts to show' message
test_cases.expected_result: User sees friendly message, no errors

test_cases.title: Media Tab Loads First 10 Media Items on Initial Render
test_cases.preconditions: User has 12 media items.
test_cases.steps:
Given the user clicks the Media tab
When the tab loads
Then the system queries Media API with limit=10
And 10 media thumbnails are displayed

test_cases.title: Media Lightbox Opens with Correct Image on Thumbnail Click
test_cases.preconditions: User has at least one media item.
test_cases.steps:
Given the user is on the Media tab
When the user clicks a media thumbnail
Then a lightbox opens
And the clicked image is displayed in full size
test_cases.expected_result: Lightbox shows correct image, navigation controls functional

test_cases.title: Network Timeout While Loading Posts Displays Inline Retry
test_cases.preconditions: User is on Posts tab, API times out.
test_cases.steps:
Given the user navigates to /profile
When the Post API request times out
Then the system displays 'Unable to load posts. Retry.' inline
And a Retry button is visible
test_cases.expected_result: Error message + Retry button, no crash

test_cases.title: Retry Button Re-fetches Posts After Network Failure
test_cases.preconditions: Previous retry attempt failed, now network restored.
test_cases.steps:
Given the user sees the retry message
When the user clicks Retry
Then the system re-queries the Post API
And posts are displayed successfully
test_cases.expected_result: Posts load after retry, message disappears

test_cases.title: Retry Button Disabled When API Still Loading
test_cases.preconditions: User clicks Retry while request in flight.
test_cases.steps:
Given the user clicks Retry
When the API request is pending
Then the Retry button is disabled
And a spinner is shown
test_cases.expected_result: No duplicate requests, UI indicates loading

test_cases.title: Posts Tab Handles 1 Post Exactly at Pagination Boundary
test_cases.preconditions: User has exactly 10 posts.
test_cases.steps:
Given the user navigates to /profile
When the Posts tab loads
Then 10 posts are displayed
And no 'Load more' indicator appears
test_cases.expected_result: Boundary condition handled, no extra request

test_cases.title: Posts Tab Handles 11 Posts (One Above Boundary)
test_cases.preconditions: User has 11 posts.
test_cases.steps:
Given the user navigates to /profile
When the Posts tab loads
Then 10 posts are displayed
And scrolling loads the 11th post
test_cases.expected_result: Pagination works for one above boundary

test_cases.title: Posts Tab Handles 9 Posts (One Below Boundary)
test_cases.preconditions: User has 9 posts.
test_cases.steps:
Given the user navigates to /profile
When the Posts tab loads
Then 9 posts are displayed
And no further load is attempted

test_cases.title: Unauthorized User Cannot Access Profile Page
test_cases.preconditions: User is not authenticated.
test_cases.steps:
Given the user navigates to /profile
When the request is made
Then the system redirects to /login

test_cases.title: Session Expiry Mid-Scroll Triggers Re-authentication Prompt
test_cases.preconditions: User is authenticated, session expires after 5 minutes.
test_cases.steps:
Given the user scrolls to load more posts after session expiry
When the API returns 401
Then the system shows a modal asking to re-login
test_cases.expected_result: User can re-authenticate without data loss

test_cases.title: Keyboard Navigation Through Posts Tab Works with Tab Key
test_cases.preconditions: User is on Posts tab.
test_cases.steps:
Given the user focuses on the page
When the user presses Tab repeatedly
Then focus moves through post cards sequentially
And pressing Enter opens the post detail

test_cases.title: Screen Reader Announces 'No posts to show' When Profile Is Empty
test_cases.preconditions: User has no posts.
test_cases.steps:
Given the user navigates to /profile
When the Posts tab loads
Then the screen reader reads 'No posts to show'

test_cases.title: Rapid Clicking Retry Button Does Not Trigger Multiple API Calls
test_cases.preconditions: Network failure on initial load.
test_cases.steps:
Given the user sees the retry message
When the user clicks Retry 5 times quickly
Then only one API request is sent
And posts load once

test_cases.title: Copy-Paste HTML into Post Text Field Triggers Sanitization
test_cases.preconditions: User is composing a new post.
test_cases.steps:
Given the user pastes '<script>alert(1)</script>' into the text area
When the post is submitted
Then the script tag is removed from stored content

test_cases.title: RTL Text in Post Title Renders Correctly in Post Card
test_cases.preconditions: User has a post with Arabic title.
test_cases.steps:
Given the user is on Posts tab
When the post card renders
Then the RTL title aligns to the right and is fully visible

test_cases.title: Zero-Width Space in Media Filename Does Not Break Lightbox
test_cases.preconditions: Media item filename contains zero-width space.
test_cases.steps:
Given the user clicks the media thumbnail
When the lightbox opens
Then the image loads correctly without broken link
